where: crates/blaze-vfs/src/lib.rs Vfs::column, Vfs::diff; crates/blaze-vfs/src/watch.rs Watcher::commit, save, apply, Batch::went; crates/blaze-cargo/src/serve/job/plan_reads.rs holds
what: Vfs::column paired the head's root with the watcher's saved stamps whatever bytes those stamps were of: a conflict (the head chose, the column saved the disk's stamp), a moved file whose source node was gone (stamp saved, nothing written, its GONE in a later record that a torn journal loses), and any commit to the head by another writer all gave a column that vouched for bytes its root does not hold, so a client slot could answer a build from stale stamps. Separately Vfs::diff named files only, so plan_reads::holds had to treat every ancestor of an added file as relisted. Found while writing the simulation test: a rename on the disk of a file whose column stamp the head chose against (a conflict, or another writer's edit) is still taken as a move of the head's bytes (Batch::went keys move sources by their plain stamp), so the target gets the head's bytes under a vouching stamp of the disk's other bytes.
cost: a wrong client hit possible on any conflict or outside commit, and on a rename after one; plans planned again for every new file under a listed directory's subtree
cause: Disk::root (the root the column holds all of) was never maintained outside replay, and Vfs::column used the head instead; a stamp had no way to say 'seen, but the head chose other bytes'; once it could, the move detection still read stamps plain
class: a cache paired with a key it was not computed against (the head's current root instead of the root its entries were saved under)
prevention: the column carries its own root, moved only by a commit that keeps the invariant (the watcher's chained batches, or Vfs::rechain over another writer's commit); Vfs::column hands it only when it equals the head; a stamp the head disagrees with carries the CHOSE bit and is handed as UNKNOWN; a move takes the head's bytes only from a source whose stamp vouches for them; watch/tests.rs a_column_never_vouches_for_bytes_its_root_does_not_hold holds every live column and every cut of the journal to the disk
fix: disk.rs CHOSE bit (chose/plain/vouches); watch.rs commit chains disk.root, conflicts saved chose, again GONE in the same SEEN record, files above a write UNKNOWN; lib.rs Vfs::rechain on commit/commit_owned/set_head and commit_seen for the watcher; Tree::relisted and Vfs::relisted; holds takes relisted. Tests: watch/tests.rs a_column_never_vouches_for_bytes_its_root_does_not_hold with three controls (Plant::ConflictVouched, AgainApart, ColumnOfTheHead), tests.rs relisted_names_every_directory_whose_listing_changed; the reference watcher and three start tests now say every start sweeps. The move-source fix is written in /tmp/plan/vfs2-next.md, not made (the test lane changes no behaviour).
